senses.sense_definition: To resolve differences or bring about a settlement between conflicting parties.

examples.text: The international organization was asked to <w>mediate</w> the ongoing border dispute.

examples.text: Both sides agreed to let a neutral third party <w>mediate</w> their disagreement.

target_lang_translations.cs: Obě strany souhlasily, že nechají neutrální třetí stranu <w>zprostředkovat</w> jejich neshodu.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Разрешать разногласия или способствовать достижению соглашения между конфликтующими сторонами.

target_lang_definitions.pl: Rozwiązywać spory lub doprowadzać do porozumienia między zwaśnionymi stronami.
target_lang_definitions.de: Differenzen beilegen oder eine Einigung zwischen Konfliktparteien herbeiführen.
target_lang_definitions.fr: Résoudre des différends ou parvenir à un accord entre des parties en conflit.
target_lang_definitions.it: Risolvere divergenze o favorire un accordo tra parti in conflitto.
target_lang_definitions.cs: Urovnat spory nebo dosáhnout dohody mezi znepřátelenými stranami.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Çatışan taraflar arasındaki anlaşmazlıkları çözmek veya bir uzlaşma sağlamak.
target_lang_definitions.es: Resolver diferencias o lograr un acuerdo entre partes en conflicto.
target_lang_definitions.zh: 在冲突各方之间进行调解以解决分歧或达成协议。

senses.sense_definition: Acting through an indirect agency or process.

senses.sense_definition: Gained or effected by a medium or specific condition.
